us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic headlines from the past 1–2 days

articles.title: AP-NORC poll finds voters want major change before midterms
bullets: A strong majority says Trump is falling short domestically and abroad.
About half want substantial change in how the country is run.
Democrats show stronger voter enthusiasm than Republicans before November elections.

articles.title: US jobless claims remain below 200,000
bullets: Initial claims rose by 1,000 to 199,000 for the week ending October 10.
Layoffs remain historically low, according to Labor Department data.
The report suggests most workers still have strong job security.

articles.title: Wholesale inflation jumps as fuel costs rise
bullets: Producer prices rose 6.3% year over year in September.
The increase was the largest since December 2022.
Higher fuel costs drove much of the acceleration.

articles.title: Trump defends Qatar-gifted jet during campaign swing
bullets: Trump defended accepting a luxury jet from Qatar for Air Force One use.
He also pitched Republicans as protectors of gun rights.
The appearances came during rallies in Arizona and Montana.

articles.title: Appeals court scrutinizes Trump’s DC National Guard deployment
bullets: Federal judges questioned limits on presidential authority over Guard deployments.
The case challenges Trump’s deployment of troops in Washington, DC.
The hearing occurred more than a year after patrols began.

articles.title: Saudi Arabia says it thwarted missile strike on Medina
bullets: The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted a cruise missile over Medina province.
Officials also reported another attempted attack in eastern Saudi Arabia.
Houthis denied responsibility for the Medina missile attempt.

articles.title: Houthis strike Saudi Aramco headquarters, officials say
bullets: Officials said the attack damaged top floors of Aramco’s Dhahran headquarters.
No casualties were reported in the strike.
The attack highlighted Houthis’ ability to hit high-profile Saudi targets.

articles.title: Ukraine resumes attacks on Russian oil refineries
bullets: Ukrainian drones hit a refinery in Russia’s Ryazan region, officials said.
The strike came after Kyiv said a brief truce was over.
The attack may further strain Ukraine’s relations with Washington.

articles.title: South Americans pray for Pope Leo XIV after cancer diagnosis
bullets: Catholics across South America offered prayers after Pope Leo’s lung cancer diagnosis.
The Vatican said he was recovering as expected after surgery.
Questions remain about his planned November trip to the region.

articles.title: IMF-World Bank meetings draw protests in Bangkok
bullets: Dozens marched near the IMF and World Bank autumn meetings in Bangkok.
Protesters cited poverty, pollution and rising inequality.
More than 15,000 officials and experts attended the meetings.

articles.title: India says first phase of US trade deal is finalized
bullets: India’s trade secretary said the first phase has been finalized.
The agreement is now undergoing legal drafting.
The deal covers a major phase in US-India trade negotiations.

articles.title: Musk vows affordable Starlink in India before Jio IPO
bullets: Musk pledged affordable Starlink service in India.
The remarks came days before Ambani’s record Jio IPO.
Satellite internet remains a major competitive issue in India.

articles.title: Supreme Court considers order on Delhi voter Form 6 plea
bullets: The Supreme Court heard a plea related to Delhi’s voter Form 6 process.
The court indicated it was thinking of passing an order.
The matter is tied to election-roll procedures.

articles.title: Supreme Court mandates insurance for offline train tickets
bullets: The court ordered insurance for passengers buying offline train tickets.
The ruling affects Indian Railways’ ticketing practices.
The decision was listed among October 15 national headlines.

articles.title: Rahul Gandhi backs protesting students, criticizes Modi government
bullets: Rahul Gandhi told students Congress would stand behind them.
He called protesting students India’s voice.
Opposition leaders criticized recent arrests of young protesters.

articles.title: AI stock anxiety weighs on markets for a second day
bullets: Tech stocks pointed to another sell-off before the opening bell.
Inflation anxiety hit high-growth AI names.
Investors looked ahead to US earnings season.

articles.title: Wall Street edges lower as investors assess big bank earnings
bullets: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq inched lower Tuesday.
Investors parsed mixed quarterly results from major banks.
Chip stocks added pressure on broader indexes.

articles.title: Micron slides as chip stocks face selling pressure
bullets: Micron Technology fell 4.6% during the chip-sector selloff.
Western Digital and Seagate also slipped between 1% and 2%.
Semiconductor weakness weighed on the Nasdaq.

articles.title: Wednesday’s major US indexes closed lower
bullets: AP reported how major US stock indexes fared on Wednesday.
The update covered trading for October 14, 2026.
Indexes reflected pressure from inflation and tech-sector weakness.

articles.title: Indian shares rise on IT, financials and Reliance strength
bullets: Indian benchmarks rose Thursday on earnings-season optimism.
IT, financials and Reliance Industries led gains.
Hot US inflation limited broader upside.

articles.title: Bumble agrees to $1.3 billion go-private deal
bullets: Bumble struck a $1.3 billion deal to go private.
The agreement comes amid an online dating industry reset.
Its market value had fallen sharply from its 2021 IPO valuation.

articles.title: Aramco headquarters damaged in Houthi strike
bullets: Officials said Aramco’s Dhahran headquarters was hit overnight.
The CEO offices and other senior areas were damaged.
No casualties were reported by officials.

articles.title: Indian rupee extends winning streak as dollar and oil ease
bullets: The rupee gained as the dollar and oil prices eased.
Indian stocks also rallied, supporting sentiment.
India’s September merchandise trade deficit was $30.21 billion.

articles.title: Wholesale inflation jump pressures businesses and consumers
bullets: Producer prices rose faster than expected in September.
Fuel costs were a major contributor to the increase.
The data raised pressure on the Federal Reserve.

articles.title: IMF-World Bank meetings open amid inequality protests
bullets: World financial leaders gathered in Bangkok for autumn meetings.
Protesters highlighted debt, poverty and environmental damage.
The meetings drew more than 15,000 participants.

articles.title: SpaceX’s Starlink affordability push targets India
bullets: Elon Musk pledged affordable Starlink access in India.
The comments came before Reliance Jio’s planned IPO.
Satellite internet competition remains politically and commercially sensitive.

articles.title: SpaceX’s Starshield draws attention as military satellite unit
bullets: Starshield develops military and intelligence satellite systems.
The business unit works with the Pentagon.
Its role differs from consumer-focused Starlink services.

articles.title: DeepMind’s Hassabis calls AI hacks early warning shots
bullets: Demis Hassabis warned AI hacks show security gaps.
He urged stronger practices for critical AI systems.
He compared needed safeguards to biology and nuclear-sector standards.

articles.title: Scientists call for international oversight body for advanced AI
bullets: Signatories from 34 countries urged stronger AI containment standards.
They focused on cyber-capable models and high-assurance safeguards.
The proposal seeks coordinated global oversight of advanced AI.

articles.title: Inflation fears hit AI-linked technology stocks
bullets: AI and broader tech stocks faced renewed selling pressure.
Higher inflation raised concern about interest-rate-sensitive valuations.
The selloff came ahead of US earnings season.
